Subject: Launch Position Update & Next Steps

Hi Avery,

I am writing to share an update on our launch position. While our launch was tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026, our release requires a completed security review approval. Nia owns the security review, which now completes on October 12 at the earliest. Because the review may require remediation, no new production date is authorized at this time. 

Please be assured that our team remains focused on moving forward effectively. While we await the completed approval, we are ready to hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data. 

As the decision-maker for this step, please let me know if you choose to accept the staging demo for October 8. 

Best regards,

Jordan
Engagement Lead
